movie.title: Bury the Devil
movie.overview: When a hospice nurse finds herself trapped with a dementia patient, she begins to suspect something else is wrong with the woman, something otherworldly, and must fight to survive the night.

reviews.author: Sierbahnn
reviews.content: It is hard to make a movie that is this small in scope and cast to feel impactful while still leaving the audience engaged with all the characters on the screen. This movie certainly tries but doesn't get all the way. The central theme is spooky and the development of it doesn't always make sense but is good enough and is acted with great conviction even though parts of the cast are probably not up to it, at least not with this director. The effects are serviceable and the movie is technically proficient in what it is trying to do, but it doesn't quite land all its beats and therefore I can't give it a higher grade.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: A hospice nurse caring for a woman with dementia comes to suspect an otherworldly presence in the house and must fight for her survival through a terrifying night.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Trapped in an isolated home during a night shift, a dedicated hospice nurse attends to an elderly dementia patient whose behavior grows increasingly eerie. As unusual occurrences escalate, the nurse realizes that the woman's condition may not be purely medical, but rather the result of a malevolent, supernatural force. With no easy way to escape, she is forced to confront the dark entity to survive until morning. The film blends psychological horror with supernatural tension to explore themes of isolation and terror.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Taking on a night shift at a secluded residence, a compassionate hospice nurse arrives to care for an elderly woman suffering from severe dementia. At first, the patient's agitation and cryptic mutterings seem typical of her declining mental state. However, as the night progresses, strange phenomena—unexplained shadows, sudden drops in temperature, and unnatural movements—begin to plague the house. The nurse attempts to remain rational, attributing the terrifying atmosphere to fatigue and the stressful environment. Her professional resolve is shattered when the patient begins speaking in voices that reveal intimate, disturbing details about the nurse's own past. Realizing that an otherworldly evil has taken root within the household, the nurse finds all exits mysteriously blocked and communication with the outside world severed. Desperate to protect both her patient and herself, she scrambles to discover the origin of the malevolent entity. Every corridor becomes a potential trap as the sinister force turns the house into a deadly gauntlet. In a harrowing climax, she must summon all her inner strength to outwit the demonic presence and survive until dawn.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: When a hospice nurse takes a night assignment caring for an elderly dementia patient in a remote home, she expects a routine, albeit challenging, shift. Instead, she is plunged into a nightmare as the patient's disturbing behavior aligns with unsettling supernatural occurrences throughout the house. As psychological dread gives way to outright terror, the nurse suspects that a sinister entity is controlling the woman. Trapped without contact to the outside world, she must navigate escalating paranormal threats and overcome her deepest fears to survive the night.

story_structure.climax: The atmospheric tension reaches a boiling point when the sinister force reveals its true intent, forcing the nurse into a desperate, harrowing confrontation to survive until morning.
story_structure.conflict: As the night unfolds, the nurse begins experiencing unsettling phenomena, leading her to suspect that the patient's terrifying behavior is driven by something far more sinister and supernatural than cognitive decline.
story_structure.resolution: In the aftermath of the terrifying night, the immediate ordeal draws to a close, leaving the nurse fundamentally altered by what she witnessed and endured.
story_structure.introduction: A hospice nurse arrives for an overnight shift at an isolated residence, tasked with caring for an elderly woman suffering from severe dementia.
story_structure.risingAction: Trapped inside the home during a intensifying ordeal, the nurse uncovers dark clues about the property's history while attempting to protect herself and navigate the patient's erratic, increasingly violent behavior.
